documentation.sourceRevision: SCLS181H, section 5 and mechanical drawing 4040049/E (14-pin MS-001 AA)

manufacturing.process: Hand-soldered through-hole. Form leads for a 7.62 mm row span and confirm fit. The 0.9 mm finished holes and 1.6 mm copper lands are TinyCAD dimensions.

variants.name: Phoenix Contact 1715721 · MKDS 1,5 · 2 positions
variants.source: Phoenix Contact 1715721, dimensions and drilling plan; TinyCAD-authored copper lands

manufacturing.process: Through-hole wave soldering. With the body centred, the double-line edge of the drilling plan is on -Y and the drill row is 4.6 mm from that edge. The square pad marks TinyCAD contact 1. The 2.3 mm copper land is a TinyCAD dimension.
